about_the_game:
Have you lost your cats? Do not worry!! Call "Cat Rescue Inc." today and we’ll track down your lost feline friends... We’ll even search through spooky, dangerous forests to bring them home! From sneaky ninja cats to diva cats, we can handle them all!

🐱 Key Features of Cat Rescue Inc.

  • Endless Adventure
    No two playthroughs are the same! Each world is randomly generated, packed with secrets, surprises, and cozy corners to explore.

  • Adorable Cat Stacking
    Every rescued cat joins your growing tower. Can you carry them all home safely?

  • Hand-Drawn World
    Enjoy a whimsical, paper cutout-inspired art style filled with charm and personality.

  • Wholesome and Non-Violent
    No combat, no violence—just you, your cats, and the joy of exploration. Enemies don’t harm you, but they will cause some chaos if you're not careful!

  • Randomly Generated Cats
    From ninja cats to diva cats, each feline has a randomly generated visual and stats.

  • Peaceful Yet Perilous
    The world is serene, but not without danger. Learn how to navigate through the woods and deal with jump-scares from mischievous critters.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E5200
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 9800GTX+ (1GB)
  • Storage: 256 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

short_description: Rescue your customers’ lost feline friends! Explore endless, randomly generated jobs. Be stealthy because the cats are watching! And beware... dangers lurk in the woods!
